INSERT INTO doc_sequence_counters (id, document_type, company, division, year, current_value, created_at, updated_at)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(ds.document_type, '-', ds.company, '-', ds.division, '-', ds.year) as id,
  ds.document_type,
  ds.company,
  ds.division,
  ds.year,
  MAX(ds.sequence_number) as current_value,
  NOW() as created_at,
  NOW() as updated_at
FROM doc_sequences ds
WHERE ds.created_by = 'historical_import'
GROUP BY ds.document_type, ds.company, ds.division, ds.year
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
  current_value = GREATEST(doc_sequence_counters.current_value, VALUES(current_value)),
  updated_at = NOW();
